description: This file defines the HardKeyboardActionImpl class, which implements the HardKeyboardAction interface. It manages keyboard actions, including key codes and modifier states, for physical keyboard input handling within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: HardKeyboardActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the HardKeyboardAction interface, handling key code and modifier states for physical keyboard input.

methods.name: initializeAction
methods.description: Initializes the action with a KeyEvent and meta state.

methods.name: isAltActive
methods.description: Checks if the Alt modifier is active.

methods.name: isShiftActive
methods.description: Checks if the Shift modifier is active.

methods.name: setNewKeyCode
methods.description: Sets a new key code and marks it as changed.

methods.name: getKeyCodeWasChanged
methods.description: Indicates whether the key code was modified.
